title: Velo Strawberry Ice Slim Nicotine Pouches - Original (10mg)
description: Velo Slim Strawberry Ice Nicotine Pouches capture the juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberry balanced with a cooling note for a flavour that tastes fresh and uplifting. The mix of berry character and menthol lift creates a clear and refreshing pouch profile. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released steadily without smoke, vapour or odour, making them a convenient choice throughout the day. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a variety of flavour profiles and strengths. Strawberry Ice comes in a Medium 10mg strength, offering a more potent release for users who prefer a stronger option. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
